style: Cinematic illustrated 2D urban storybook, clean black contours, warm amber and cool blue accents, consistent realistic perspective. No anime redesign. 16:9, one continuous cinematic frame per scene. No panels, split screen, collage, inset frames or white gutters. No lettering or speech bubbles.
character: Same iconic protagonist: pale minimal face with two oval eyes, messy short dark hair, oversized orange headphones, teal hoodie and dark trousers. Never normal-detailed face for protagonist.
supporting: Background supporting people may have ordinary stylized eyes, nose and mouth; never copy protagonist's minimal facial design or teal/orange outfit.
